name: Luon Cave
summary: Water cave on the long boat: row or kayak through the notch into a lake on a 5–6 hour route. Endemic plants and macaques live around the lake, and Soi Nhụ shell layers sit 3–4 m above the water, dated 18,000–7,000 years. A kayak is 50,000 đồng a trip for two people. You stay in the boat the whole way through.
getThere: Route 2 boat, then a small boat through the tunnel
heroCaption: The notch at the waterline, with rowing boats

notice.title: You stay in the boat
notice.body: You stay in the boat. A kayak at Luồn is 50,000 đồng a trip for two people. A rowboat is 30,000 đồng a person. Sửng Sốt, earlier on the same route, is the cave you walk.

body: The notch goes through the foot of the island. You row or kayak into the lake. The port names endemic plants and macaques. On the same page, Soi Nhụ shell layers sit 3–4 m above the water and are dated 18,000–7,000 years.
The clock is the 5–6 hour route with Ti Tốp and Sửng Sốt. The kayak price is on top of the route ticket.

figures.caption: Inside the tunnel, with boats
figures.alt: Boats inside Hang Luon Cave in Ha Long Bay

gettingThere: Route 2 from Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Hạ Long, then a small boat. The route clock is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn together.

legs.heading: From the Ha Long port
legs.body: The route-2 boat, then a rowboat at 30,000 đồng a person or a kayak at 50,000 đồng a trip for two people.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Confirm the sailing the day you go.
admissionNote: No separate cave price. Route 2 on 15 March 2024 is 490,000–510,000 đồng. Kayak at Luồn, updated 9 November 2024: 50,000 đồng a trip for two people. A rowboat is 30,000 đồng a person. From 10 December 2025 a bay ticket needs an identity card or a passport.
